Name: Window air conditioner
Description: A box in a sash window with its condenser hanging out over the street. A compressor, a fan on a shroud, and a thin steel case that lets all of it straight out — which is why you hear these from the pavement and barely at all from the room they are cooling. The model is SmallMachines.AirConditionerWindow: a constant-speed machine with no governor, so its note does not move, and everything you hear happening to it is the world between you and it.
